steps.description: GREEN: index.ts:124 replace the description template (v = name.replaceAll('_','-')): `Consume exact human intent and perform direct ${v} authority. Intent exists ONLY when the operator typed /${v} as their literal prompt this turn; free-text prose does not carry it. After the verb completes, carry forward any remaining instruction from the prose.` (use name.replaceAll('_','-') inline for each ${v}). git-authority.ts:556 AND :612 APPEND to both refusal strings (identical): throw new Error('Direct Git operation requires a matching human intent — the operator must invoke the rendered git form (/commit, /commit-and-push, or /push) as their literal prompt; free-text prose does not mint intent').
